newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Civilian said killed in Sri Lanka rebel attack.
newsitem.headline: Civilian said killed in Sri Lanka rebel attack.

text.p: Suspected Tamil rebels exploded a landmine and opened fire on a civilian vehicle in Sri Lanka's north, killing one person and wounding six others, military officials said on Tuesday.
The attack took place late on Monday at Mamaduwa, a village just east of Vavuniya, a government stronghold 220 km (140 miles) north of the capital Colombo, the officials said.
The rebels shot at two vehicles carrying people to a funeral. Among the wounded were five members from the same family, including a six-year-old girl, they said.
The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in this predominantly Sinhalese island, were not immediately available for comment.
A Defence Ministry statement said on Tuesday that rebels had shot and wounded a villager at Parasankulam near Mamaduwa on Monday afternoon while he was fishing at a lake.
The government says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE says the toll is much higher.
